description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pohoddaramulla, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad Map No. 530014
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, property rights, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land ownership and property registration matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
